OWLUMI HELP

Need a hand? 🦉

Quick, built-in help for using Assessment Tracker. Nothing here is an AI chat and nothing is sent anywhere.

🚀 Getting started: How do I upload my spreadsheet?
  1. Fill in the Owlumi Assessment Tracker spreadsheet as usual.
  2. Open Assessment Tracker and choose your spreadsheet when prompted.
  3. Owlumi reads the spreadsheet locally on this device.
  4. Choose a class to open its dashboard.

Your student spreadsheet is not uploaded to an online server by this tracker.

📈 How do I check a student's progress?
  1. Open a class dashboard.
  2. Choose the student from the student list.
  3. Use the current-year sections for assessment and component trends.
  4. Use Across academic years to see progression between recorded years.

Raw percentages are shown first. A smaller pp figure means percentage-point change.

🗓️ How do I add a previous academic year?
  1. Load the current Assessment Tracker spreadsheet first.
  2. Open Student History.
  3. Choose Add Previous Year.
  4. Select an earlier Owlumi Assessment Tracker spreadsheet.
  5. If Owlumi finds a possible returning student, confirm the match before records are linked.

You can add earlier spreadsheets even if you only started using Student History this year.

💾 What is Student History and how do I keep it?

Student History is the local record that connects the same learner across academic years. Use Transfer / Restore Student History when moving the history to another device, and keep the downloaded Owlumi history backup somewhere safe.

🟢🟡🔴 What do the progression colours mean?
  • Green — Improving: recent recorded performance is meaningfully higher.
  • Yellow — Steady: the change is small enough to be treated as broadly similar.
  • Red — Needs attention: recent recorded performance is meaningfully lower and is worth reviewing.

The colours highlight recorded patterns for teacher review; they are not judgments about a student.

👀 What do the Class Progression cards mean?
  • Showing Progress: stronger recent recorded performance.
  • Needs a Closer Look: recent performance is below the earlier pattern.
  • Recurring Support: the same recorded component has fallen below 50% more than once.
  • Variable Progress: recorded results vary substantially over time.

Click any card to see the affected students, then choose View student to inspect the evidence.

🦉 Assessment Tracker updated to Version 3

Here’s what changed in this update:

  • Choose six Owlumi colour themes, complete with matching flowers and background decorations. Your choice is remembered on this device.
  • The original spacious dashboard layout is restored, with class card subtitles removed.
  • Component results now appear in compact rows with assessment names taken directly from your spreadsheet.
  • Includes the corrected spreadsheet with marks checked against all assessment and component maximums.
  • Student ID stays optional; the tracker uses name and class when no ID is supplied.
